categories.main_business_segments: Dong Sung Bio Pharm operates primarily in three business segments: pharmaceuticals, hair dye products, and cosmetics. The pharmaceutical and hair dye products are mostly produced in-house at the Asan factory, while other products are mainly procured and sold. Key pharmaceutical products include treatments for diarrhea, hair loss, pain relief, dementia, antibiotics, motion sickness, and skin diseases. Cosmetics and hair dye brands include 'Rangs' and 'AC.CARE'.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing processes compliant with KGMP standards, producing drugs and medical supplies. It also engages in photodynamic therapy (PDT) research and development, including clinical trials with laparoscopic PDT for cancer treatment. Core technologies include cannabinoid-based drug development, chlorin e6-curcumin conjugates for photodynamic cancer therapy, and proprietary extraction and synthesis methods for natural compounds. Production capacity is centered at the Asan plant with an 82% utilization rate.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include hospitals, pharmacies, drugstores, and online retail channels domestically. The company also exports pharmaceuticals and cosmetics to international markets including China, Vietnam, Guatemala, Japan, Southeast Asia, South America, and Europe. Sales channels encompass direct sales to medical institutions and indirect sales through wholesalers. The company targets both consumer health markets and specialized medical treatment sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Dong Sung Bio Pharm operates mainly in South Korea with headquarters in Seoul and production in Asan. It has 18 business locations nationwide including research centers in Asan, Seoul, and Daegu. Internationally, it exports and distributes products in China, Vietnam, Guatemala, Japan, Southeast Asia, South America, and Europe, with ongoing efforts to expand global distribution channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical and cosmetics supply chain. It manufactures key products in-house, including pharmaceuticals and hair dyes, while also procuring and distributing other products. It engages in R&D and clinical trials, positioning itself as a developer and producer rather than a raw material supplier or purely a distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on innovative drug development, especially in photodynamic therapy for cancer and cannabinoid-based treatments for neurological diseases. The company invests in R&D for new drugs, improved formulations, and medical devices, supported by a dedicated research staff of 63 across multiple specialized labs. It also emphasizes expanding global market presence and diversifying product lines in response to evolving market needs and regulatory environments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pharmaceuticals, hair dyes, and cosmetics both domestically and internationally. The company also earns income from licensing technology and exclusive distribution agreements. Sales are conducted via direct and indirect channels including hospitals, pharmacies, wholesalers, and online platforms. Export contracts and supply agreements with overseas distributors contribute to revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dong Sung Bio Pharm competes in the Korean pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries against other domestic and international firms. It holds a mid-sized market position with established brands and a focus on specialized therapeutic areas and functional cosmetics. The company leverages its R&D capabilities and long-standing market presence to differentiate itself amid intense competition and regulatory challenges.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported annual revenues of approximately 886 billion KRW, with a slight decline of 5% from the previous year. It achieved an operating profit turnaround with 596 million KRW compared to a loss in the prior year. Total assets stood at about 1.15 trillion KRW, with a 6.75% increase year-over-year. The company maintains a moderate growth trajectory while focusing on profitability and cost reduction.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dong Sung Bio Pharm emphasizes product quality, innovative therapeutic solutions, and a diversified portfolio including pharmaceuticals, functional cosmetics, and hair dyes. Its competitive edge lies in proprietary R&D, especially in photodynamic therapy and cannabinoid-based drugs, and strong domestic brand recognition. The company also focuses on expanding global distribution channels and adapting to market trends such as online sales and medical cosmetics to sustain growth and customer loyalty.
